title: ConnectionStatus
description: The overall connection status of plugs and slots on the system.

established.description: A list of connections that are currently established.

undesired.description: A list of connections that have been manually disconnected.

plugs.description: A list of all available plugs.

slots.description: A list of all available slots.

Connection.description: Represents a connection between a specific plug and slot.

interface.description: The name of the interface governing the connection.

manual.description: True if the connection was established manually.

gadget.description: True if the connection is defined by the gadget snap.

slot-attrs.description:
A map of the slot's attributes.
These are negotiated by and belong to the connection.

plug-attrs.description:
A map of the plug's attributes.
These are negotiated by and belong to the connection.

snap.description: The name of the snap providing the plug.

plug.description: The name of the plug itself.

interface.description: The interface name for the plug.

attrs.description:
A static map of the plug's attributes.
These are attributes that belong to the plug

apps.description: A list of apps associated with this plug.

label.description: The display label for the plug.

connections.description: A list of slots this plug is connected to.

PlugRef.description: A reference to a specific plug.

snap.description: The name of the snap providing the plug.
The name of the snap providing the slot.

slot.description: The name of the slot itself.

interface.description: The interface name for the slot.

attrs.description:
A static map of the slot's attributes.
These are attributes that belong to the slot

apps.description: A list of apps associated with this slot.

label.description: The display label for the slot.

connections.description: A list of plugs connected to this slot.

SlotRef.description: A reference to a specific slot.

snap.description: The name of the snap providing the slot.
